faqSeatA: A seat is one protected unit: a named Scan asset, a Host site, an Uptime monitor, or a Guard agent. It is not a user account.
faqChangeQ: How do I upgrade or downgrade?
faqChangeA: Send a request from this page. Ops reviews it, issues an invoice, and applies the new SKU after payment. Downgrades are blocked while usage exceeds the target tier.
faqGuardQ: Is Guard included with Host Protect?
faqGuardA: Yes. Guard is included at no extra charge while Host Protect is active. Do not count Host and Guard as two separate lines.
faqAnnualA: Annual is prepaid: pay 10 months for 12. It does not stack with other promotions.
faqTaxA: No. Prices are list prices and exclude tax. The invoice confirms the final amount.
faqCancelQ: How do I stop the subscription?
faqCancelA: Contact ops. There is no self-serve cancellation in this phase; access follows the paid invoice period.
